NewsArticle.Title: Temporary Guild Error
NewsArticle.Content: Early this afternoon there was a temporary guild error. We fixed the error at 4:29 p.m. PDT. We apologize for the temporary inconvenience. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
